title: AI infrastructure capex cycle — implications for Contoso AI & Infrastructure Thematic
content: We see the 2026-2028 hyperscaler AI capex cycle continuing to support the thematic, with three sub-themes leading: (1) accelerator silicon and packaging, (2) datacenter power and cooling, (3) grid-edge build-out. Fund is overweight power+cooling and underweight pure-play model providers given valuation. YTD return +12.7%; trailing-30d +5.2%. Our base case: capex moderates from late-2027 as a digestion phase begins; downside scenario is a 25% drawdown. Suitable for growth-mandate clients; not suitable for income-mandate or conservative-segment portfolios.
